n: Café Customfit Stainless Interior Dishwasher With Ultra Wash & Dry, 42 Dba
hl: Load more than just silverware in this redesigned basket.
This dishwasher with 4 bottle wash jets ensures a deep clean for tall items, narrow glasses, jars and more.
Choose from six unique CAFÉ™ handle finishes to complement the rest of your kitchen thanks to this dishwasher with customizable hardware.
Easily save your favorite wash and dry option combinations to the 'Favorites' button on your control panel for convenient and quick access at the touch of a button.
Load the dishwasher your way thanks to an adjustable middle rack.
Loosen tough soils with a presoak cycle that runs before the wash cycle begins, so you can skip the need to pre-rinse or soak items by hand.
